title: Replacing an item at a supermarket
objectives: Explain the problem and when you bought the item
Show the receipt and ask for a fresh replacement
Ask which item has the latest date

courseTemplate.setting: The shopper bought the bread yesterday and has the receipt. A refund or fresh replacement is available.

roles.learner: A shopper with a spoiled loaf of bread

courseTemplate.openingLine: Hello. What can I do for you today?

targetPatterns.pattern: I bought this bread yesterday, but it's already mouldy.
targetPatterns.example: I bought this bread yesterday, but it's already mouldy.

targetPatterns.pattern: Here it is. Could I get a fresh loaf instead?
targetPatterns.example: Here it is. Could I get a fresh loaf instead?

targetPatterns.pattern: Which loaf has the latest expiry date?
targetPatterns.example: Which loaf has the latest expiry date?

targetPatterns.pattern: Excuse me, where can I find oat milk?
targetPatterns.example: Excuse me, where can I find oat milk?
targetPatterns.translation: 请问燕麦奶在哪个货架？

targetPatterns.pattern: Is this on sale this week?
targetPatterns.example: Is this on sale this week?

targetPatterns.pattern: Do I need a membership card for this price?
targetPatterns.example: Do I need a membership card for this price?
targetPatterns.translation: 这个价格需要会员卡吗？

targetPatterns.pattern: Could I have these in a paper bag?
targetPatterns.example: Could I have these in a paper bag?

targetPatterns.pattern: What's the difference between these two brands?
targetPatterns.example: What's the difference between these two brands?
targetPatterns.translation: 这两个牌子有什么区别？

targetPatterns.pattern: Is there a self-checkout I can use?
targetPatterns.example: Is there a self-checkout I can use?

targetPatterns.pattern: Can I get a refund for the expired yogurt?
targetPatterns.example: Can I get a refund for the expired yogurt?

stages.title: Explain the problem and when you bought the item
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Hello. What can I do for you today?”
successCriteria: The learner can explain the problem and when you bought the item in their own words.
hints: You can start with “I bought this bread …”

stages.title: Show the receipt and ask for a fresh replacement
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have your receipt?”
successCriteria: The learner can show the receipt and ask for a fresh replacement in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Here it is. Could …”

stages.title: Ask which item has the latest date
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Of course. You can choose another loaf from the shelf.”
successCriteria: The learner can ask which item has the latest date in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Which loaf has the …”

modelDialogue.text: Hello. What can I do for you today?
I bought this bread yesterday, but it's already mouldy.
I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have your receipt?
Here it is. Could I get a fresh loaf instead?
Of course. You can choose another loaf from the shelf.
Which loaf has the latest expiry date?
